name: clock-face
prompt: Extension layer: an analog clock face whose hands follow the composition time; color controls for the face and hands and a size slider.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

summary: I wrote the `gen.analog-clock` layer definition, but haven't compiled, registered or rendered it because no Powermove tools were attached. The hour, minute and second hands take their positions from the composition time (`iGlobalTime`) plus a Start Time offset, which defaults to 10:08. The docs don't say whether fragment layers get `iGlobalTime`/`iResolution` or whether `uv` starts at the top-left, so the shader may not compile or the clock may draw upside down. Controls (all keyframeable): Size, Face Color, Hand Color, Second Hand Color, Marks Color and Start Time.
